marks.term: KYE AI Solutions Framework Authority Pack
marks.notes: KYE Sector Pack Foundry™ expert-pack (KYE-FOUNDRY-PACK-AI-SOLUTIONS-FRAMEWORK-AUTHORITY-001) turning the AI Solutions Framework — an enterprise AI-adoption control framework of ~90 safeguards across AI governance & accountability, risk management, AI safety, data privacy/lineage, compliance monitoring, and audit & evidence (IG1–IG3 maturity) — into executable authority flows at the action boundary. Positioning: frameworks define what should happen; KYE resolves who may make it happen, under what authority, and proves it later. §70 honesty bar: KYE governs ONLY the runtime-authority-resolvable subset (approval workflow, attestation, human-oversight stage gate, exception register — 6 enforced action-boundary controls); the organisational safeguards (governance board, AI inventory, policy authorship, training, risk committee) and the deploy-time infrastructure-posture / CSPM safeguards (model-logging, encryption, IAM least-privilege, network egress) are out of scope and honestly ceded to their owning roles. KYE COMPLEMENTS a deploy-time posture/CSPM layer — never claims it. Coverage is never inflated to 100%. Constitution §54 §13 / §68 / §70.

The umbrella category Governance for the AI Web™ addresses: the inability to reconstruct who authorised what, under what delegation, relying on which models/vendors, across a shared AI ecosystem. Distinct from systemic financial risk and systemic model risk — it is the risk that accountability itself cannot be reassembled after an AI-mediated action. KYE Protocol™ reduces it with the EXISTING rails (canonical ID format, §17 Directory, §13 Evidence Pack™, §30 WORM, Authority Finality™, §52/§0.30 delegated-agent binding). §0.25 honest boundary: KYE asserts only verifiable facts — evidenced / governed / disclosed / authority-exists — never a truth score. Constitution §0.16 positioning canon.

The web/consumer channel of the Governance for the AI Web™ category: a privacy-by-design browser extension that overlays authority + evidence onto the web a person and their agents browse. Local processing, no user-browsing exfiltration, opt-in telemetry only. Positioning arc: secure browsing → trusted browsing → governed browsing. A NEW public-facing PRODUCT over EXISTING rails — it surfaces the canonical kye:<class>:<trust-domain>:<subclass>:<local> ID, the §17 Directory projection, and §13 Evidence Pack™ provenance, and adds no new authority machinery. §0.25 / §70 honesty bar: it shows evidenced / governed / disclosed / authority-exists, NEVER a true/false truth score. Constitution §0.16 positioning canon.

The web/publisher channel of the Governance for the AI Web™ category: a site scan + badge that lets a publisher disclose the authority and evidence posture of a site, with public lookup via the KYE Site Authority Registry™. The site UUID IS the canonical kye:<class>:<trust-domain>:<subclass>:<local> ID (reused, never forked); the registry is a §17 Directory projection; the disclosed evidence is a §13 Evidence Pack™ under §30 WORM with Authority Finality™. §0.25 / §70 honesty bar: the badge attests evidenced / governed / disclosed / authority-exists — never a truth score. Privacy-by-design. A NEW public-facing PRODUCT over EXISTING rails. Constitution §0.16 positioning canon.

The public registry behind KYE Site Authority™: a §17 Directory projection that lets anyone look up a site's disclosed authority + evidence posture by its canonical kye:<class>:<trust-domain>:<subclass>:<local> site UUID. Reuses the EXISTING Directory rail — a projection, not a parallel registry (§0). §0.25 / §70 honesty bar: entries assert evidenced / governed / disclosed / authority-exists, never a truth score. Constitution §0.16 positioning canon.

The software-supply-chain channel of the Governance for the AI Web™ category: a GitHub App governing the authority, evidence, and provenance of software supply-chain changes — builds, dependency updates, and releases. A NEW public-facing PRODUCT over EXISTING rails: change provenance is a §13 Evidence Pack™ under §30 WORM with Authority Finality™; the actor (human or agent) resolves to a canonical principal via the kye:<class>:<trust-domain>:<subclass>:<local> ID and §52/§0.30 delegated-agent binding. §0.25 / §70 honesty bar: it proves who authorised the change and what evidence it relied on — evidenced / governed / disclosed / authority-exists — never a truth score. Constitution §0.16 positioning canon.

The DevOps/runtime channel of the Governance for the AI Web™ category: governing the authority of SRE / incident / production actions (e.g. an autoheal-partner integration acting on production). A NEW public-facing PRODUCT over EXISTING rails: each production action's authority and evidence is a §13 Evidence Pack™ under §30 WORM with Authority Finality™; the acting human or agent resolves to a canonical principal via the kye:<class>:<trust-domain>:<subclass>:<local> ID and §52/§0.30 delegated-agent binding. §0.25 / §70 honesty bar: it proves who authorised the production action and on what basis — evidenced / governed / disclosed / authority-exists — never a truth score. Constitution §0.16 positioning canon.

KYE Sector Pack Foundry™ expert-pack (KYE-FOUNDRY-PACK-PRODUCTION-ACTION-AUTHORITY-001) governing the authority and evidence of AI SRE / incident / production actions at the action boundary — the moment an AI-generated incident response moves from finding a fix toward EXECUTING a production action (a mitigation applied, a rollback, a hotfix deployed, an infra-change committed, an alert suppressed, a customer status posted).
